comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus snap a specimen swab at its breakpoint while retaining the tip in a loose transport tube.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds concentric screw and nut tooling; the swab task braces a very light tube while bending a thin shaft to controlled fracture, then disposes of the handle.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks locked angle retention through cycles; swab scoring requires a valid in-tube break, no spill or tip escape, handle in the waste cup, upright tube, rest, and gripper clearance.
comparison.reason: Bimanual reaction control is shared, but calibrated locking and controlled fracture are meaningfully different abilities.
